# HEIC decoding

`heic2any-0.0.4.min.js` is copied without changes from `heic2any@0.0.4`,
`package/dist/heic2any.min.js`. MIT license: `heic2any-LICENSE.md`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any
- SHA-256: `0963cfa50e9e1e7e6af929a40a81e3e898a673f1270eafa6917dd137e4968164`
- npm package tarball SHA-1: `eddb8e6fec53c8583a6e18b65069bb5e8d19028a`

The pinned local asset decodes an OCR copy. It does not receive a network upload,
and original Drive bytes remain in private `invoice-sources` storage. The browser
tries its native decoder first and loads this asset only when needed.
